description: NASA SEDAC publishes one-kilometre population and urban-classification grids derived from India’s 2011 census. The product combines official settlement categories with remotely sensed built-up land from the Global Human Settlement Layer and includes a hybrid urban classification. NASA’s current Earthdata landing page and official data.gov metadata identify the dataset and DOI. The describing article states a CC BY dataset licence, permitting free reuse. These national grids can support simulations that allocate infrastructure demand or compare population exposure under alternative definitions of urban settlement. The original CIESIN address is broken and its legacy SEDAC download page timed out during this review; only the replacement metadata page was verified. The data describe 2011, not current settlement patterns. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: India census population and urban-class grids 2011
